newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Southeast Oct load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Southeast Oct load factor rises.

text.p: Atlantic Southeast Airlines Inc said on Friday that its October load factor increased to 50.3 percent from 46.3 percent in October 1995.

Revenue passenger miles for the month increased 17.7 percent to 78.6 million from 66.8 million, while available seat miles increased 8.3 percent to 156.3 million from 144.3 million in October 1995, the carrier said.
Atlantic Southeast said the number of passengers in October increased 22.1 percent to 326,052 from 267,113 in October 1995.
In the year to date period, the carrier's load factor increased to 49.5 percent, up 4.4 percentage points from 45.1 percent in the first ten months of last year, Atlantic Southeast said.
Revenue passenger miles for first ten months of 1996 increased 16.6 percent to 740.9 million from 635.5 million in the year ago period, the carrier said.
Available seat miles increased 6.2 percent to 1.50 billion from 1.40 billion, the carrier said.
